newsitem.title: GERMANY: German unions say sick pay talks resume on Monday.
newsitem.headline: German unions say sick pay talks resume on Monday.

text.p: Talks between management and workers on resolving the current dispute over sick-pay in Germany are to resume on Monday at 1300 GMT in a hotel near Frankfurt, the powerful IG Metall union said on Saturday.

Werner Stumpfe, president of the employers' union Gesamtmetall, and Dieter Hundt, Gesamtmetall vice-president, will meet with Klaus Zwickel, IG Metall chairman, and Walter Riester, vice-chairman of IG Metall, said an IG Metall statement.
The dispute concerns a controversial new law which is aimed at cutting the cost to companies of sick-pay entitlements.
